headings.usage: All page titles, modal headers, major stats. Tight tracking (-0.02em on font-heading-xl).

body.usage: Standard text, menus, tables. Optimized for readability.

numbers.usage: PRICES, TIMERS, ORDER NUMBERS, TOKENS, RECEIPT TOTALS. Glare-proof condensed numerals for kitchen/counter readability. Must keep tabular-nums.

ink.usage: Primary buttons/CTAs, active states, emphasis text

night_shift.strategy: Class-based (html.dark) + CSS variable overrides + legacy utility shim (html.dark .bg-white etc). Do NOT hardcode hex in JSX - use tokens.

warning.usage: Low stock, pending, delayed KDS orders

info.usage: Informational chips/badges only - NEVER for primary CTAs or brand moments

retired_colors.saffron: #F59E0B - retired as brand accent (allowed only inside ChefBot illustration + functional warning)

chart_palette.note: Neutral grayscale 5-step (chart-1..chart-5) driven by CSS vars; use for all Recharts series.
chart_palette.rationale: Grayscale charts stay readable in both themes; status semantics come from labels, not chart colors.

pos_mode.grid: Bento Grid for Menu Items (Responsive: 2 cols mobile, 4 cols tablet, 6 cols desktop)
pos_mode.navigation: Top navbar desktop + bottom bar + Sheet drawer mobile

admin_dashboard.structure: Sidebar Layout (bg-slate-900, always dark - independent of theme)

theme_toggle.desktop: Sun/Moon icon button in POS navbar + Admin sidebar
theme_toggle.mobile: Night Shift row in POS Sheet menu
theme_toggle.persistence: localStorage key 'dd-theme'; no-flash inline script in public/index.html

buttons.primary: bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-700 (light) - inverts via --dd-ink token in dark

cards.style: Flat with 1px border (var(--dd-border)) or shadow-sm; use .dd-card / .pos-card utilities
cards.hover: shadow elevation change; translate-y-[-2px] on menu-item-card

inputs.style: h-11/h-12 (Touch Optimized), var(--dd-bg) background, focus: ink border + 25% ink ring via .dd-input/.pos-input

badges.style: .dd-badge-* utilities; status badges keep functional colors with tinted backgrounds

visual_enhancers.shadows: Neutral diffuse shadows (card/elevated vars; dark variants auto-applied)

calm_mode.description: Signature feature: slows all transitions to 0.8s for a calm visual rhythm
calm_mode.implementation: .calm-mode class on html/body; transitions colors/shadows/opacity ONLY (perf-safe, never layout props)

visual_enhancers.motion: fadeInUp page entrance, stagger-1..6 delays, hover-lift; always respect prefers-reduced-motion

accessibility.contrast: AA in both themes; status colors brightened under html.dark
accessibility.text_on_ink: Always white on ink (light) / night on inverted ink (dark) - never black-on-black

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use blue/saffron for primary actions - ink only.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings - use Manrope.
Do NOT use Poppins/Montserrat/Plus Jakarta Sans - they are retired.
Do NOT hardcode #1E3A8A, #2563EB, saffron hexes, or dd-blue/dd-saffron classes.
Use var(--dd-*) tokens or theme-aware utilities for anything theme-dependent.
Always add hover effects: brightness/translate-y or elevation.
Ensure high contrast on ink backgrounds (white text on ink).
New pages must support Night Shift: check dark rendering before merge.
Functional status colors (success/warning/error/info) may never be used as brand/CTA colors.
